title: 廢金屬渦電流分選
summary: 以「導電感應、粒子軌跡與非鐵回收」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow induction, particle trajectories and non-ferrous recovery through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

steps.checkEn: Double flux-change time and compare induced voltage.
